presets.name: Playden default
presets.try_when: Every game starts here. Uses the recipe's values.

presets.name: Mouse-driven game
presets.try_when: The game has no controller support and is played with a mouse: strategy, adventure and menu-heavy games.

presets.name: Keyboard game on a controller
presets.try_when: The game reads only the keyboard. Buttons send the keys most games use.

presets.name: OpenGL game
presets.try_when: Older engines that draw with OpenGL, such as id Tech and GoldSrc games.
